# CloudDevs

> > CloudDevs connects US companies with pre-vetted senior developers from Latin America, offering 24-hour hiring with 60% cost savings across Python, JavaScript, React, Java, C#, and 100+ technologies.

CloudDevs specializes in recruiting remote LATAM developers from Mexico, Brazil, and other Latin American countries, providing flexible hiring options from hourly contracts to full-time positions. The platform also offers comprehensive technical guides and tutorials across major programming languages and frameworks.

## Key Topics

- LATAM developers
- Pre-vetted senior developers
- Remote developer hiring
- 24-hour hiring process
- Python, JavaScript, React, Java, C#, PHP
- Latin America talent pool (Mexico, Brazil)
- Risk-free trial periods
- Hourly and full-time contracts
- International payroll and compliance
- Agile methodology
- Mobile app development (iOS, Android)
- RESTful APIs
- Software development workflows
- Developer recruitment platform
- Cost-effective nearshore hiring

## Hiring Services

- [Hire LATAM Developers | Vetted and Ready in 24 Hours](https://clouddevs.com): Homepage: Hire pre-vetted LATAM developers in 24 hours, save 60%
- [Hire Software Developers from Your Time zone within 24 Hours](https://clouddevs.com/software): Hire vetted software developers from preferred time zones in 24 hours
- [Hire Individual Developers](https://clouddevs.com/individual-developers): Hire individual LATAM developers with flexible pay-as-you-go contracts
- [Long Term Hiring](https://clouddevs.com/long-term): Hire full-time LATAM developers for permanent positions
- [Technologies Directory](https://clouddevs.com/technologies): Directory of 100+ technologies with specialized senior developers
- [Jobs Board](https://clouddevs.com/jobs): Job board for remote LATAM developers at US companies
- [Hire Android Developers](https://clouddevs.com/android): Hire senior Android developers in 24 hours from LATAM talent pool
- [Payroll Services](https://clouddevs.com/payroll): International payroll, compliance, and benefits service for LATAM hires
